name: Survey tile in Capricornus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.2 degrees north of the ecliptic in Capricornus, imaged by SPHEREx 11 times in 4 visits over 38 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 22 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 38 hours starting 2025-11-06, at wavelengths from 0.92 to 4.41 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
